description: The file defines a PHP class 'Resource' within the SuiteCRM API, specifically handling JSON API resource objects, including parsing, validation, and serialization of resource data adhering to the JSON:API specification.

classes.name: Resource
classes.description: Represents a JSON API resource object, providing methods for parsing incoming data, validating, and generating proper JSON API responses, including handling attributes, relationships, and links.

methods.name: fromJsonApiRequest
methods.description: Populates the resource object from a JSON API request array, setting attributes, type, and relationships, and handling errors if required keys are missing.

methods.name: mergeAttributes
methods.description: Merges attributes from another Resource object into this one.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON API formatted response array with all attributes.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponseWithFields
methods.description: Generates a JSON API response array including only specified fields.

methods.name: withLinks
methods.description: Sets the links object for this resource.

methods.name: withRelationship
methods.description: Adds a relationship to this resource.

methods.name: getReservedKeywords
methods.description: Returns all the reserved keywords used in JSON API syntax that should not be used in attribute names.
